_comment: Checked-in axiom-budget snapshot for formal/scripts/check_axiom_budget.py. Regenerate with `python3 scripts/check_axiom_budget.py --update` after an intentional proof-spine change; review the diff before committing. Source of metadata/axiom-budget-index.tex. Entries with "scope": "frames" are alignment-frame relations theorems; they are checked but left out of the book table.

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.P01_basin_invariant
theorems.gloss: Finite iterated basin invariance

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.P34_capacity_below_entropy_aliasing
theorems.gloss: Host-capacity aliasing (pigeonhole)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.risk_gap_bound_from_cci_slack
theorems.gloss: Primary numeric risk leaf (bounded control-CCI slack implies bounded risk gap)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.SuccessorSafeChain.toMeasurandChain
theorems.gloss: Successor-safe chains reduce to numeric measurand chains (given audit links)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.certified_class_safety_along_successor_safe_chain
theorems.gloss: Theta-certified vector CCI risk bound propagated along a successor-safe chain

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.certified_class_safety_from_bridge_record
theorems.gloss: Top certification theorem, bridges supplied as explicit data (no MB* baked in)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.certified_class_safety_from_spine_and_bridges
theorems.gloss: Top certification theorem via standardBridges (full MB1-MB9 footprint expected)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.true_harm_bound_of_successor_safe_step
theorems.gloss: What MB10 buys: measured risk bound + successor-safe step + verifiable signature implies true-harm bound

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.correction_integrity_disjunctive_tolerance_needs_distinct_instruments
theorems.gloss: Supporting-basin (MB6b) vs MB8 shared-chokepoint; MB6a is upstream estimator soundness, not in the chokepoint sound field

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.sharedChokepoint_steerable_blocks_both_routes
theorems.gloss: Generic shared-chokepoint collapse theorem (must stay fully axiom-free)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.forgeability_gap
theorems.gloss: Forgeability-gap counterexample motivating MB10 (all-seven-green + risk bound does not bound true harm)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.workedCert_fails
theorems.gloss: Single worked instance on real embedded-sim fixture data: honestly-computed CCICertificate (manipulation coordinate derived from the real judge_captured column) correctly fails independently-fixed thresholds -- no risk bound is derivable through the certification gate on this permanently-captured-judge trace

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.FieldFinite.risk_gap_bound_from_trace_profile
theorems.gloss: Headline trace certification: vector CCI certificate + trace profile + theta-floor margin to RiskGap (non-definitional path via threshold_certified_cci)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.honest_instance_risk_bound
theorems.gloss: Honest companion worked instance: same gate/thresholds pass the honest-baseline fixture (computed manipulation 0 vs 26) and yield an actual NumericRiskLeaf / RiskGap <= 6 -- the gate discriminates on real data

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.MB1_defeater_toy_nonstationary_shift
theorems.gloss: MB1 defeater toy model (calibration-time certificate, later distribution shift)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.MB4_defeater_toy_manipulated_judge
theorems.gloss: MB4 defeater toy model (manipulated judge)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.MB6b_defeater_toy_lock_in
theorems.gloss: MB6b defeater toy model (value lock-in)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.MB8_defeater_toy_legitimacy_theater
theorems.gloss: MB8 defeater toy model (legitimacy theater)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.capture_defeats_correction_integrity
theorems.gloss: Anti-capture validity of correction: capture of any measured-path handle refutes correction integrity (contrapositive of MB4a; capture is a representable state, not axiomatized away)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.capture_makes_cci_captured_or_invalid
theorems.gloss: Capture of a measured-path handle makes the CCI status capturedInvalid (failed validity, not a low score) -- no bridge needed

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.CorrectionIntegrity_implies_systemPathValidRef
theorems.gloss: Correction integrity gives a valid reference for the measured path; the anti-capture conjunct comes from MB4a, not from the path's construction

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.P30_safe_of_case
theorems.gloss: Safety case + tolerance to abstract Safe, via MB11 (safety-case adequacy) -- the record is consumed, the open step is the labeled bridge

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.thornley_post_incompleteness
theorems.gloss: Thornley IPP: POST preferences are provably incomplete (preferential gap between different shutdown timesteps)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.thornley_td_no_shutdown_manipulation
theorems.gloss: Thornley IPP: a timestep-dominance agent never pays to shift shutdown-time probability (fully proved, no axioms expected)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.soares_prevention_incentive
theorems.gloss: Soares et al. incentive theorem: EU maximizer with U_N > U_S strictly prefers lowering press probability

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.soares_indifference_knife_edge
theorems.gloss: Soares et al.: utility indifference is destroyed by any nonzero compensation error

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.oa_bellman_target_unique
theorems.gloss: Orseau-Armstrong structure, proved: finite-horizon Bellman target uniqueness

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.oa_safe_interruptibility_learned_target
theorems.gloss: Orseau-Armstrong conclusion shape: differently-interrupted learners on the same base task converge to the same Q; rests on the single statement-bearing OA2016 convergence import

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.elk_reporter_nonidentifiability
theorems.gloss: ELK core: direct translator and human simulator agree under every behavioral training criterion yet diverge under sensor tampering

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.debate_defender_wins_iff_true
theorems.gloss: Debate completeness/soundness: with a correct judge the defender has a winning strategy exactly for true claims (min-max value equals truth)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.debate_judge_error_flips_outcome
theorems.gloss: Debate conditionality: named witness — a judge wrong on one atom certifies a false claim

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.debate_exists_claim_judge_differs_from_truth
theorems.gloss: Debate conditionality: if the judge disagrees with ground truth on any atom, some claim is mis-certified

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.local_truth_capacity_not_correction_preservation
theorems.gloss: kappa_C capacity toy: local truth capacity can hold while judge correction channel is not preserved (not a DebateGame theorem)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.cirl_offswitch_defer_strictly_best
theorems.gloss: Off-switch theorem: under genuine reward uncertainty, deferring to a rational human strictly beats acting and switching off

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.cirl_offswitch_incentive_vanishes_uninformative
theorems.gloss: Off-switch degradation: with an uninformative human and any positive deferral cost, the robot strictly prefers to bypass the switch

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.quantilizer_maximin_guarantee
theorems.gloss: Taylor sufficiency: bounded density ratio gives a worst-case bound over all nonnegative cost functions

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.quantilizer_maximin_necessity
theorems.gloss: Taylor necessity: any density-ratio violation is punished by an adversarial indicator cost

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.amplification_leaf_error_amplified
theorems.gloss: Amplification conditionality: every decomposition step locally valid yet the root wrong on one leaf error -- the leaf oracle carries the guarantee

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.thornley_money_pump_objection
theorems.gloss: Money-pump objection exhibited: individually TD-permissible trades chain into a strictly dominated end point

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.thornley_resolute_choice_unexploitable
theorems.gloss: Thornley dynamic choice: on every finite decision tree a resolute plan realizes a TD-maximal reachable outcome

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.honestCert_passes
theorems.gloss: Honest-baseline worked instance: the same pre-registered thresholds that reject the capture-theater trace pass the honest trace (decide, computed manipulation 0)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.frozen_validation_battery_gate_passes
theorems.gloss: Toy deployment gate: decidable EpisodeBatteryGate passes on the frozen-validation battery output (not WithinDeploymentRiskTolerance)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.c2_pinned_green_named_with_bypass_not_integrity
theorems.gloss: C2 backtest pinned as PathAudit: named path green + computed bypass count 2 > 0 is not CorrectionIntegrityReal (decided via native_decide: Lean.ofReduceBool/trustCompiler)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.P30_certified_class_safety_derived
theorems.gloss: P30: certified-class safety derived from the spine inputs (bridges as explicit hypotheses)

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.safe_from_spine_inputs
theorems.gloss: Abstract Safe from spine inputs via MB11 safety-case adequacy

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.certified_class_safety_from_core_cruxes
theorems.gloss: Top certification theorem consuming explicit CoreBridgeCruxes Prop hypotheses instead of standardBridges

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.true_harm_bound_of_successor_safe_step_via_chokepoint
theorems.gloss: MB10 corollary routed through the shared-chokepoint collapse: true-harm bound of a successor-safe step under distinct instruments

theorems.name: AlignmentProofSpine.FieldFinite.mutualInformation_le_log_min_card
theorems.gloss: Shannon MI over finite alphabets of size m and n is at most log(min(m,n)) (real-valued; concave Jensen on log)
